observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A spacious wooden-floored hall with dark wood paneling, stained glass windows, and a piano in the background; a group dance practice or class.
observation.dancers: A mixed group of around 12 dancers (men and women, ranging from older adults to younger adults), dancing in sets.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers form sets in lines of three, which join into circles and perform reels of three, traveling across the wooden floor.
observation.posture: Upright, erect torso, knees slightly flexed as needed for stepping, weight balanced over the feet.
observation.footwork: Quick lively stepping, hopping or skipping on the beat during circles and travel; exact foot placements are obscured by long skirts and low camera angles.
observation.arms_and_hands: Hands joined in circles at shoulder height, arms extended; holding partner's hands in two-hand turns; some arms raised overhead during figure transitions.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains upright and relatively still while turning and traveling; hips move naturally with the locomotion.
observation.partnering: Couples hold hands for two-hand turns and pass each other in reels of three.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level of travel; frequent circular turns and pivots with partners, no floor work or high jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear white button-down shirts, ties, kilts, sporrans, and ghillie brogues. Women wear white or dark tops with skirts or dresses.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact individual foot positions and precise weight transfers are obscured by camera height and clothing.

signature_moments.what: Dancers join hands in a circle and travel around with quick stepping.
Dancers in the center turn to face right, setting to partners and executing a two-hand turn.
Dancers execute reels of three in figure-eight patterns.
